study_system.region: Sierra Nevada foothills wetland metapopulation, California, USA
study_system.scientific_role: fresh independent candidate for the post-Glanville two-layer EOG-WF predictor

source.dryad_dataset_title: Stability of patch-turnover relationships under equilibrium and nonequilibrium metapopulation dynamics driven by biogeography
source.transport_resolution: public Dryad landing page -> exact individual published file download links; checksum every file before scientific parsing
source.checksum_status: must_freeze filename, byte size, and SHA-256 for each published file at Gate 0
source.transport_change_boundary: Changing from an authenticated API bundle route to public landing-page individual-file routes is a transport-only correction. No file may be substituted, renamed scientifically, or selected based on response contents.

public_documentation_basis.repeat_detection_design: up to three call-playback visits each summer (five in 2002), with removal-style revisit stopping after detection
public_documentation_basis.process_match: small specialised wetland patches occupied year-round, with published annual colonisation/extinction modelling
public_documentation_basis.external_comparator_class: dynamic multi-season occupancy/metapopulation turnover models with area, isolation, patch quality and matrix covariates

rationale: the published study explicitly treats the 307 wetlands as a metapopulation and models annual colonisation/extinction
the focal rails are reported to reside year-round in the wetland patch system rather than being seasonal breeding-site visitors only
the EOG claim will be conditional on realised occupied sources inside the declared regional wetland universe
process_closure_gate.claim_boundary: No claim of complete closure to every immigrant originating outside the approximately 2000-km2 study region. Forecast claims remain conditional on the declared internal wetland-source system unless external source states are prospectively represented.

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen rule/world identities retained for sequential compatibility, contraction and finite-universe falsification
two_layer_architecture_freeze.predictive_layer: symmetric_world_support_summary_v1 from eog.v2.reachability; arbitrary world IDs are not supervised predictive columns

allowed_at_gate0: published file bytes for checksum and byte-size identity only
Dryad landing-page HTML for transport resolution
exactly the first physical header line of each detection-history CSV; no data rows
forbidden_before_later_gates: published derived annual outcome table as a modelling response

pass_if: every expected public file can be resolved from the published Dryad landing page and checksummed
README/schema confirms stable site identifiers and machine-readable spatial information or a deterministic site distance/isolation representation
detection history remains separable from non-response site geometry/covariates
survey years and repeat-detection structure are compatible with prospective temporal holdout
conditional internal-source metapopulation interpretation remains scientifically defensible
stop_if: published source files cannot be frozen through lawful public routes
basic node/world inputs require reading detection-history response rows
external immigration makes an internal-source conditional forecast scientifically indefensible

primary_vs_secondary_species_rule.primary_confirmatory_species: California black rail, because it has the longer 2002-2019 series
primary_vs_secondary_species_rule.secondary_species_role: Virginia rail is supportive within-system replication only and is not counted as a fully independent regional system

post_gate0_sequence: freeze response-blind process/world scale rules and structural adequacy criteria
freeze current-source update semantics and symmetric_world_support_summary_v1 predictive representation
freeze dynamic-occupancy and flexible external comparators plus temporal holdout
only then open California black rail detection history once
use Virginia rail only under its predeclared supportive role
no_rescue_rule: If this candidate fails a pre-response scientific gate, stop without opening detection-history rows and do not change the gate to force eligibility. Transport-only corrections that do not alter files or scientific rules must be recorded explicitly.
